candidate_source: Sorted union of official audio_pseudo_label and video_pseudo_label values from the three pinned CA-MER annotation files; no semantic merging.
shared_instruction: Select exactly one label from the candidate list that best describes the emotion conveyed by the provided input. The candidate list is: {{CANDIDATES_JSON_ARRAY}}. Return only a JSON object with the single key label, for example {"label":"neutral"}. Do not include explanation or any other keys.

A_ONLY.media_contract: One separately derived mono 16 kHz audio file; no video, subtitle, transcript, source label, reasoning, sample metadata, or other textual payload.

V_ONLY.media_contract: One separately derived video with exactly one video stream and zero audio streams; no source audio, subtitle, transcript, source label, reasoning, sample metadata, or other textual payload.

A_THEN_V.media_contract: Separate mono 16 kHz audio followed by silent video. The video has zero audio streams. No modality-named text headings or source metadata.

V_THEN_A.media_contract: Silent video followed by separate mono 16 kHz audio. The video has zero audio streams. No modality-named text headings or source metadata.

rendering_rules: Use the exact same candidate set and per-sample candidate ordering in all four arms.
Place the shared instruction last in every arm.
Do not add modality-named headings, source pseudo-labels, final_label, emotionllama_pseudo_label, reasoning, subtitle, transcript, or analysis text.
Use no model-generated explanation; preserve the exact raw response for later parsing.
